title: Coin the category Deterministic State; the thesis line is the public positioning
context: David wants to plant a flag fast. The homepage still sells the developer tool (Project DNA hero); the README and changelog carried the thesis but nothing public and dated named the category. Evidence from the Sofia pilot (baseline: 2 of 3 replies unsourced, repeated re-summaries) is not yet re-measured, so a full repositioning would be a promise, not a result.
decision: The category is named Deterministic State (two words, capitalized as a category). The public thesis line is: Agents are probabilistic. Organizations need deterministic state. Hunch is the layer that holds it between agents and the organization. Coined by a dated, pinned blog post in all five site locales (slug the-state-layer, 2026-09-08) plus a thin band above the homepage navigation linking to it in every locale. The DNA hero stays until the Sofia re-measurement lands; then the hero swaps to the thesis and the DNA story becomes section two. Product name stays Hunch; Nuryel remains deferred (a product name is not a category).
consequences: Every locale has a dated URL for the thesis; the sitemap lists five.
The previously pinned research post is unpinned (one pinned post by convention).
The hero swap is gated on a measured number from Sofia plus a second agent.
External copy (LinkedIn, WhatsApp) uses the exact thesis line and the category name verbatim.
alternatives_rejected: Coin 'the state layer' as the category — rejected by David: the category is Deterministic State; 'state layer' describes Hunch's role, not the category.
Replace the homepage hero with the thesis now — rejected: trades a working developer pitch for an unproven claim; revisit when the pilot number exists.

Add a standalone /state page and a nav item — deferred: nav parity spans 26 templates across five locales (constraints con_7405203f23, con_e3cc8bb530); the pinned post is the dated flag and costs a fraction.
Announce on Hacker News now — rejected: one shot there, and it punishes claims without numbers; LinkedIn + WhatsApp group now, HN after the measurement.

premises.claim: The thesis post exists on the site in the source blog data
The pilot re-measurement is due after Monday's baseline compare; re-attest this positioning once the number is public
